explosion_small.what: A small unit blows up, and small blasts.
explosion_small.a: Round pop: a short thump with a soft noise tail
explosion_small.b: Sharp crack: more snap, less bass

explosion_large.a: Deep boom: a low thump, a long rumble and a little air
explosion_large.b: Crunchy blast: a hard crack over a shorter, grittier rumble

bomber_blast.what: A Bomber lands and explodes: the biggest unit blast.
bomber_blast.a: Heavy slam: a very low thump, a long rumble and a shockwave swell
bomber_blast.b: Double hit: the landing thud, then the blast a moment later

mine_blast.what: One of the Mines goes off.
mine_blast.a: Buried thump: a muffled, earthy boom with falling dirt
mine_blast.b: Trigger and blast: a metal click, then a sharp blast

death_small.a: Pop and scatter: a quick thump, then bits of metal
death_small.b: Dry burst: short and hard, almost no tail

death_large.what: A large unit is destroyed: two blasts, the second 0.28 s after the first.
death_large.a: Two booms: a blast, then a deeper one, and a long rumble
death_large.b: Blast and wreck: one big blast, then metal groaning and falling

shell_impact.what: An Artillery shell lands (the standard blast).
shell_impact.a: Thud and dirt: a low hit with earth thrown up
shell_impact.b: Hard hit: a crack with a short, tight boom

shell_impact_large.what: The big Artillery shell lands: the largest blast in the game.
shell_impact_large.a: Earth-shaker: a very deep boom with a long rolling tail
shell_impact_large.b: Crack and roar: a hard crack, then a gritty roar that fades

building_collapse.what: A building falls down over about 1.5 s.
building_collapse.a: Rolling crumble: a long rumble with a few heavy thuds
building_collapse.b: Cracks then crash: sharp breaks, then one big crash and dust

bomber_leap.what: A Bomber jumps into the air toward its target.
bomber_leap.a: Whoosh: air rushing as it takes off
bomber_leap.b: Spring: a quick rising pitch, like a launch

burn_death.a: Flare-up: a rush of flame that dies down, with crackle
burn_death.b: Burst and hiss: a small blast, then a long hiss

flame_ignite.a: Whoomp: a soft low burst that opens up

shot_flamethrower.what: A Flamethrower fires; repeats while it keeps firing.
shot_flamethrower.a: Roar: a wide, fluttering jet of flame
shot_flamethrower.b: Gas jet: a brighter hiss over a low growl

sniper_shot.what: The Sniper fires after aiming: one heavy shot.
sniper_shot.a: Rifle crack: a sharp crack that echoes away
sniper_shot.b: Crack and zip: the crack with the round whipping off

shot_sniper.what: The older Sniper shot sound. I could not find it played anywhere since v0.20 gave the Sniper sniper_shot.
shot_sniper.a: Lighter rifle crack (the same idea as sniper_shot A, shorter)
shot_sniper.b: Lighter crack and zip (the same idea as sniper_shot B, shorter)

shot_turret.what: One shot of the Gun turret, which fires ten a second.
shot_turret.a: Tight tap: short and dry so ten a second stay separate
shot_turret.b: Thump: lower and rounder, more like a heavy gun

sniper_aim.what: The Sniper aims for 2 s before firing; the sound runs the whole aim.
sniper_aim.a: Rising tone: a quiet hum that climbs and tightens
sniper_aim.b: Lock-on beeps: ticks that speed up until the shot

dig.a: Crunch: a gritty bite into rock with a small thud

wall_hit.what: A shot hits a wall or rock.
wall_hit.a: Stone thunk: a dull knock with a puff of grit
wall_hit.b: Ricochet: a hard ping off the surface

repair.what: A Builder repairs: a very short tick, repeated.
repair.a: Metal tick: a small bright tap

alert_mine.what: The alert you hear when one of your own Mines goes off, wherever you are looking.
alert_mine.a: Two falling beeps: a clear warning, lower than the under-attack alarm
alert_mine.b: Low thump and ping: a muffled bang, then a marker tone
